music.title: Music — full songs & music videos
music.size_label: large — ComfyUI runtime + music weights (already staged)
music.manual_note: The Music 3 ComfyUI runtime and its weights must already exist at ~/runtime/music3-iso/ComfyUI; the repo ships no automated download for them.

steps.label: Start the music engine
steps.run: systemctl --user reset-failed media-lab-comfy-music.service 2>/dev/null; systemd-run --user --unit=media-lab-comfy-music.service bash -lc 'cd "$HOME/runtime/music3-iso/ComfyUI" && exec .venv/bin/python main.py --disable-api-nodes --listen 127.0.0.1 --port 8196 --disable-auto-launch --extra-model-paths-config extra_model_paths.yaml'

image.title: Image studio — Qwen-Image-2.1 generation & editing
image.blurb: Qwen-Image-2.1 is the studio's only image model (generation, editing, transparency).
image.size_label: large — 30.84 GiB of BF16 weights plus a pinned image runtime
image.manual_note: Weights and the runtime are not downloaded by the repo: stage Qwen-Image-2.1 (revision b3179ad355be050328e483a9dfdd9e60cd62adfa) using config/qwen-image-21-weights.json, then point the image host at it. The ComfyUI path additionally needs a build with the Qwen-Image-2.1 nodes; the accelerated NVFP4 pack is pinned in config/model-manifests.json.

steps.label: Check the pinned weights are staged
Start the image engine
steps.run: systemctl --user reset-failed media-lab-comfy-image.service 2>/dev/null; systemd-run --user --unit=media-lab-comfy-image.service bash -lc 'cd "$HOME/runtime/comfy-ltx25/ComfyUI" && exec .venv/bin/python main.py --disable-api-nodes --listen 127.0.0.1 --port 8195 --disable-auto-launch'

voicebox.title: Voicebox — clone yours, give characters theirs
voicebox.blurb: Voice cloning and character voices (Qwen TTS, Kokoro…).
voicebox.manual_note: Voicebox is a separate TTS service this repo does not ship an installer for. If it is already running on port 17493 it shows as ready; otherwise install and start it by hand (see AGENTS.md), then reopen this screen.
